component.name: Voice2Text-AI
component.summary: Local voice transcription and AI assistant

description.p: Voice2Text-AI is a desktop voice assistant for recording speech, transcribing it with Faster Whisper, and sending text to local Ollama models.
It supports microphone dictation, clipboard copying, local AI responses, and text-to-speech output with an open-source offline eSpeak NG fallback.
Patch release replacing Google TTS fallback with offline open-source eSpeak NG fallback, updating the visible app version, and keeping the slim CPU Linux build.
